On October 21, 2026, Cushman & Wakefield Ltd. (the “Company”) issued a press release announcing the completion of the Redemption (as defined below in Item 8.01). A copy of this press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to the Current Report on Form 8-K. The information contained in Exhibit 99.1 hereto shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing. Item 8.01 Other Events. On October 21, 2026, Cushman & Wakefield U.S. Borrower, LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, fully redeemed (the “Redemption”) the remaining $150 million principal amount outstanding of its 6.750% Senior Secured Notes due May 2028 (CUSIP 23166MAA1; U1272MAA5) (the “2028 Notes”), completing the retirement of the 2028 Notes and eliminating the Company’s nearest debt maturity. Following the Redemption, there are no long-term debt arrangements maturing prior to 2030. Capitalized terms used in this Item 8.01 and not otherwise defined in the Current Report on Form 8-K shall have the respective meanings ascribed to them in the Indenture governing the 2028 Notes.
